merge_critic_results.reason: These adjacent lessons overlap in what they establish.

lessons.title: Multiply a two-digit number by a one-digit number without regrouping
lessons.objective: Multiply a two-digit number by a one-digit number using place value and the standard procedure when no regrouping is required.
must_establish: Multiply the ones place value by the one-digit number
Multiply the tens place value by the one-digit number
Record the resulting two-digit product correctly in the standard algorithm layout

lessons.title: Multiply a two-digit number by a one-digit number with regrouping in the ones place
lessons.objective: Multiply a two-digit number by a one-digit number using the standard procedure when the product in the ones place is 10 or greater and regrouping to the tens place is required.
must_establish: Identify when a product in the ones place requires regrouping
Regroup the tens value from the ones product into the tens place
Add the regrouped value to the product of the tens place

lessons.title: Solve two-digit by one-digit multiplication problems using the standard procedure
lessons.objective: Solve a two-digit by one-digit multiplication problem using the standard procedure, including cases with and without regrouping.
must_establish: Apply the standard procedure consistently to problems with and without regrouping
Verify a multiplication result for reasonableness using estimation or place value
